title: Gravity Pyramid Safety Game

title: Pipeline Safety Intelligence
summary: A data-driven workflow focused on pipeline incidents, people safety and process safety.
description: Case study spanning data overview, cleaning, transformation, dashboarding, reporting and responsible use. Public deployment and source files are not yet attached to this Lab.

title: Calgary Fuel Price Forecasting
summary: Six AI-assisted approaches to Calgary fuel-price forecasting, documented with a seven-part comparative study.
description: Dedicated case study compares ChatGPT, Google Notebook/Colab, AI Studio, Perplexity, Claude, and Gemini. Only ChatGPT workflow metrics are currently evidenced; other platforms await independent results.

title: Building Energy ML
summary: Energy prediction exploration comparing decision-tree methods and prepared feature sets.
description: Building-energy machine-learning exploration with multiple preprocessing iterations and model evaluation. This page intentionally does not claim that a public app is deployed.

title: Calgary Fleet Analytics
summary: Power BI fleet analytics using trip, vehicle and delivery-site data.
description: Fleet-data case study covering operational KPIs and idling analysis. An external dashboard link can be added when approved for public distribution.

title: 3D Printing & Practical Prototypes
summary: A space for practical prototypes, engineering designs and maker experiments.
description: A planned gallery for selected 3D-printing and DIY work. Individual project evidence and images can be uploaded through GitHub as they become available.
